main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (about 30x30 px) on a thin brown trunk with a dark grass patch at the base
top_band: No flat top surface for an organic canopy. At x=15 the upper canopy runs from row 0 to 9 in mid and light greens (L 81-135) with the highlight clump at rows 4-8. The darker mass runs from row 10 to 23, with a lighter underside at rows 24-30. The trunk is brown (L 70) at rows 32-43.
evidence: This is a volumetric blob canopy, not a flat-topped object. Its lit upper-right highlights, dark inner shading and dark outline give a rounded form, and the canopy overhangs and shades a visible trunk. It has no isometric side face and is not a flat elevation. For an organic kind this reads acceptably as 3/4. The lighter underside of the canopy is slightly odd, but it is not a contract failure.

style.evidence: The canopy uses six green steps (L 25-170) with a dark green-tinted outline (0% neutral edge pixels), and it has no 5x5 flat fills. It is still far below the references on the measured facts. It has only 11 distinct colours against 427 and 567, and a median of 7 colours per tile against about 108. Next to the Beodeul trees it is a simple blotchy pixel clump with no per-leaf clusters, no trunk texture and little trunk shading, and the trunk is a thin flat brown column. It looks thinner and flatter than the references.
